name: Kakutou Cosplay Ojanko
source:
A strip mahjong game with cute girls in cosplay outfits. There are six contestant available from the start, but become the strongest player - and more hidden characters will show up.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一款与身穿角色扮演服装的可爱女孩对战的脱衣麻将游戏。最初有六名对手可供选择；当你成为最强玩家后，还会有更多隐藏角色登场。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
